does_not_authorize: publishing, uploads, mass-edits or changes to current YouTube videos
vidIQ_note: vidIQ screenshots / optimize scores can suggest improvements but do not guarantee views. Live keyword metrics were not retrieved because the integration had no credits in the preceding check; never invent scores.

title.hashtags_in_title: normally_zero; at most one when clearly useful

description.preferred_length: short contextual paragraphs; never pad to reach a score

hashtags.hard_rule: relevant only; never use unrelated trending hashtags

validation: Compare the actual intended YouTube channel ID with the approved registry entry before applying channel-specific metadata.
Verify that metadata refers only to that channel's exact present branding, or mark upcoming branding as planned; reject stale/foreign brands (Arquivo Otaku in Otaku Multicena).
Verify all claims, tool versions, dates, prices, experiment outcomes, rights and source descriptions against the real video.
Reject repeated description blocks, full narrated scripts copied twice, hashtags unrelated to the video, deceptive titles and repeated tags.
Avoid claims like 'testei' unless the experiment was actually executed and shown.
Treat vidIQ scores as diagnostic hints, not YouTube ranking guarantees.
For children-directed videos never include requests for comments, likes or subscriptions directed at children.
No upload, automatic metadata update, or publication is implied by this policy.
For Gamer, NEVER request, capture, fetch or portray recorded gameplay; use AI illustrations and append honest disclaimer.
For IA, replace 'Testei por Você!' with 'IA Sob a Lupa' when no real experiment exists; no fake UI/screenshots or test claims.

br.description_focus: anime + specific series/character and factual detail; CTA to adult/general anime fans

en.description_focus: English anime explanation with series, character and verified factual detail

games.description_focus: game title + verified curiosity/nostalgia/news, with clearly marked AI-generated illustrations and NO actual gameplay
games.mandatory_disclosure: 🎨 Visuais ilustrativos gerados por IA; não são capturas de gameplay.

kids.description_focus: gentle episode description for parents/guardians, accurate characters and sequence, music rights

alchemy.description_focus: factual tool/model explanation and conceptual tutorial illustrated with AI-generated art; no tests or UI claims without real evidence
alchemy.mandatory_disclosure: 🎨 Ilustrações geradas por IA. Resultados de testes só são afirmados quando verificados.

short_example.suggested_title: Death Note: por que saber o nome NÃO é suficiente? 📓
short_example.suggested_description:
Você sabia que conhecer o nome de alguém não é suficiente para usar o Death Note? 📓

Existe uma regra fundamental: quem escreve no caderno também precisa visualizar o rosto da pessoa. Isso impede que outras pessoas com o mesmo nome sejam atingidas por engano.

Descubra por que essa regra torna o confronto entre Light Yagami e L ainda mais interessante.
